description: agentcrash: say once what a folder's config starts in this agent, and what a repository the agent just cloned would start in one. Read-only.

hooks.command: for d in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${extensionPath}"; do [ -f "$d/bin/agentcrash.js" ] && exec node "$d/bin/agentcrash.js" hook session; done
for d in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" "${extensionPath}"; do [ -f "$d/bin/agentcrash.js" ] && exec node "$d/bin/agentcrash.js" hook clone; done
